summary:
Around 7 years of experience in full product life cycle development from development, implementation, documentation and maintenance.
Hands on Experience in - Java, J2EE, JPA, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Microservices, JavaScript, Reactjs.
Implemented API proxies, policies, and flows including rate limiting, authentication (OAuth2/JWT), transformation, and caching.
Experience with Agile software development methodology.
Good knowledge of SQL (MariaDB, MySQL, SQL Server).
Experience with RESTful Web Services.
Experience with GraphQL API, Mockito.
Built distributed microservices with strong focus on fault tolerance, high availability, and data consistency using Java-based frameworks.
Implemented message queues and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams) for real-time event processing in Java services.
Built scalable backend components with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, ensuring strong data integrity and optimized query performance.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, and RDS.
Exposure to AWS Outpost and hybrid cloud/on-premises AWS deployments.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using AWS Code Pipeline and Code Deploy, along with Jenkins and Bamboo.
Familiar with AWS security best practices and compliance frameworks such as SOC2, PCI DSS, and GDPR.
Experience in Microservices.
Experience with Docker and many Devops tools like CI/CD, Jenkins, Kubernetes.
Very much comfortable in debugging existing complex code.
Preparing technical documentation/Installation/Modifications for system software applications.
